name: Hansel to Gretel DS
original_name: ヘンゼルとグレーテルDS
source:
Your destiny will change depending on the path you choose.

Is it a beast that attacks the two? A witch? Or...

Please guide them to the ultimate "hunt" ending.

[Edited and translated from[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/20188] Freem[/url]]
translation:
你的命运会根据你选择的道路而改变。

难道是有猛兽袭击了两人？女巫？或者…

请引导他们走向最终的“狩猎”结局。

[编辑并翻译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/20188] Freem[/url]]
